optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Wealth Services Platform

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the model evaluation harness and the labelled adviser-review set.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.

experienceHighlights.text: Runs pre-release evaluations for each model version and publishes the evaluation report.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Reduces the false-alert rate seen by advisers, reported against the documented quarterly baseline.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.

skills.text: Coordinates release decisions with the model team and adviser operations and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated release decisions in the model release meeting; the model team lead took the go/no-go decision and adviser operations confirmed the alert-volume impact.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience in maintaining the evaluation harness, running pre-release evaluations, reducing the false-alert rate, coordinating release decisions, and documenting evaluation assumptions. They do not establish the candidate's ability to handle production deployment or the exact metrics used for the quarterly baseline.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and performance are well-documented, but further human review is required to assess fit for the role.
